name: KID Mix Section ~Character Collection~
original_name: KIDミックスセクション キャラクターコレクション
source: There's been a bug that has invaded four KID games and mixed the worlds up! With the help of a tiny AI called Aine, the main character will have to help the heroines get their worlds back.
translation: There's been a bug that has invaded four KID games and mixed the worlds up! With the help of a tiny AI called Aine, the main character will have to help the heroines get their worlds back.
